title: The purpose of this meeting is to finalize the Committee's interim work. The Committee will take final action on outstanding bill drafts as the 2027 General Session approaches. The Committee will consider bills concerning workers compensation coverage for mental health coverage for emergency communications professionals and ski patrol. The Committee will also discuss a physician assistant licensure compact and expanded scope of practice for pharmacists.
